resourceBenchmark.scope: One run, total .pack throughput 10 Mbps and 150 ms request delay; authenticated resource readiness only. Excludes physics settling, shader compilation and final visible frame.

limits: First native shader/engine initialization remains hardware-dependent. Software Chromium public test measured silk readiness 7.54 s cold and 6.10 s after reload; no universal instant-load claim.

Public software-renderer seven-material regression measured denim readiness around 121.44 s and leather 27.76 s; this release chiefly removes avoidable optical network/decoding work, not all native compilation costs.

Knit screenshots use original reference geometry with test-only manual paused drawing, pixel ratio 1, temporal accumulation and 2x static supersampling disabled. Shipped quality defaults are preserved.
Phone testing is CSS viewport 390x844 only; no physical-device or 60 FPS certification.
Cotton, acrylic and linen entries remain appearance-only; other materials retain original individual solvers. Shader rules remain inert drafts.
Complete private link includes an access capability and should not be published. It is not DRM.
